embeds.title: 🧪 poison decay, explained
embeds.description:
v0.8.0's patch notes mentioned it in one line — here's what it actually means for the two rats built around it.

**Draughtsman Moe** and **Plague-Bearer** apply poison that now halves after every tick it deals damage, settling at a floor set by the single strongest dose you land — not a flat wall. Merge still matters: a ★3 lands a bigger dose, so it decays down to a bigger floor. A lone ward can blunt a tick, but can't zero the stack outright.

Same fade applies in reverse when a Plague-Doctor or Midden-Hag rots one of yours.

Day gate 2 dropped this morning — **Draughtsman Moe** (cost 8, plague) is sitting in the shop right now if you want to feel the new curve for yourself.
